cards.answer: Vayne is a marksman and assassin with an AD focus. She repositions with Tumble for empowered physical attacks and rewards repeated hits on the same target with maximum-health true damage. Final Hour strengthens her attacks and pursuit while adding Tumble invisibility.
cards.counterplay: Limit extended trades and avoid fighting with terrain behind you.

cards.answer: Final Hour grants bonus attack damage, increases Night Hunter's movement speed bonus, and reduces Tumble's cooldown. Tumble also grants brief invisibility; attacking or casting abilities ends the stealth. Champion takedowns shortly after she damages the victim can extend Final Hour.
cards.counterplay: Create distance during Final Hour and account for invisible repositioning.
